source: KV cache persists across autoregressive decoding because future tokens attend to keys and values from earlier positions. Its footprint grows with sequence length in ordinary cached attention, so long-context decode can create substantial persistent memory demand and read traffic.
zh: KV 缓存在自回归解码过程中持续存在，因为未来的令牌会处理早期位置的键和值。它的占用空间随着普通缓存注意力中的序列长度而增长，因此长上下文解码可以产生大量的持久内存需求和读取流量。
